data.overallsummary: The story begins with a violent car crash, followed by Grand Dad faking his death and collapsing. Rahul and Arjun travel to India for Dadu's heart attack, leading to family conflicts over finances and a heated argument between the brothers. Arjun storms out, attends a party where he meets Tia, and later drives a drunk Wasim home. Rahul and his father discuss properties for Rahul's artist retreat and Dadu's Bangalore treatment, which Grand Dad refuses, preferring to celebrate his 90th birthday at home with a family photo. Rahul and Arjun reconcile, and Rahul visits Tia's bungalow for his retreat, sharing an awkward moment. Grand Dad continues his crude humor in the hospital, enjoying a Mandakini scene on an iPad. Arjun is at Wasim's photo studio when he spots Tia near a pan bidi shop. Arjun and Tia discuss "sweet cigarettes" from her childhood. Wasim emerges with a Mandakini cut-out, which Arjun reveals is Dadu's birthday gift, prompting Tia to playfully tease Dadu. Wasim invites Arjun to Boobly's event, and Arjun invites Tia. Arjun and Wasim are decorating for Grand Dad's birthday. Rahul, trying to contact Dadu's friends, asks his mother for an old phone diary. His mother provides the diary, advising him to call Nabeel Kaka on a landline, and Rahul informs her that Chachu will arrive soon. She cautions him not to mention the past fight with his father to Chachu. Rahul then calls Chowdhary Kaka but learns of his passing, adding to the list of Dadu's friends who have passed away. Arjun expresses concern about low attendance for the party, suggesting Rahul invite their father's friends. Rahul and his mother then move to the kitchen, where she feeds him a momo, and Rahul questions her about her frequent arguments with his father, offering support for her to join Timmy Maasi's business. In the kitchen, Rahul's mother expresses her feeling of being unappreciated by her husband, who she believes only praises "Anu." Rahul tries to comfort her, suggesting they talk calmly as adults, but then retracts the "adults" comment upon seeing Arjun and Wasim playfully stuffing balloons under their shirts to mimic breasts and popping them in the background. Rahul invites his mother to stay with him in London for a few days so she can get to know him better. His mother, while expressing concern for him, urges him to leave his foreign girlfriends and marry a good Indian girl to make her a Dadi. Arjun and Wasim continue their playful antics with balloons, mimicking pregnancy, which makes Rahul laugh. Rahul then checks his watch and announces he has to leave. Rahul is at Tia's bungalow where Tia playfully asks him about his fears, to which he jokingly replies "mice." Tia's domestic help, Kishore, tries to invite Tia to a Nepali movie, but Tia feigns not understanding Nepali, amusing Rahul. After dismissing Kishore, Tia asks Rahul for a good restaurant recommendation. Rahul suggests "Shinchows" for its chilly chicken, and Tia invites him to join her, which he accepts after a moment's thought. They then leave the bungalow together. Tia realizes Rahul doesn't have his car and an auto won't be available, so Kishore gives them a ride on his old moped, with Rahul awkwardly sandwiched between Tia and Kishore. Tia jokes that the moped and Kishore come free with the house. They arrive at a small, crowded North Eastern restaurant where, mid-meal, Tia finds the spicy food delicious. Rahul offers her a beer and then points out food stuck in her teeth, embarrassing her. At the restaurant, Tia playfully teases Rahul about something on his nose, then asks him to choose between chicken stuck in teeth or a booger hanging from the nose as more "yucky," to which Rahul emphatically chooses the booger. They share momos and beer, and Rahul makes Tia comfortable by eating a momo that slipped from her chopsticks. An hour later, after several drinks, Tia challenges Rahul to come to the dance floor if she does something crazy, asserting that "madness has no limit." She then approaches a bald man at a nearby table, dabs his head with a tissue, kisses it, and playfully whacks him, claiming it was a mosquito. After this, Tia cringes and wipes her mouth, then returns to her table, with Rahul laughing. She then challenges Rahul to join her on the dance floor. They are now on a small dance floor, doing their own silly rendition of dance moves. Rahul demonstrates his "milkshake," "ironing," and "car washer" steps, while Tia shows her "shampoo ad" step and, when very high, her "sexy chakki peesne waali" step. After their dance, Tia and Rahul return to her bungalow, only to find it in a blackout due to a blown fuse. As they try to fix it with a phone torch, Tia screams upon seeing a mouse, which scares Rahul, causing him to scream and fall. Tia finds this amusing, leading Rahul to call her mean. They then giggle while trying to figure out how to reach the fuse box, which is at an awkward height, and Tia wonders how her domestic help, Kishore manages it. Rahul offers to lift Tia so she can fix the fuse. Despite her initial hesitation, he lifts her by the waist. They laugh while trying to fix it, with Rahul jokingly commenting on her weight. A wire sparks, scaring Tia, and they continue to laugh. Rahul eventually brings her down as he can't hold her anymore. Still tipsy and in the dark, Tia unexpectedly kisses Rahul. Their moment is interrupted by Kishore's voice, who arrives with a lantern, and Tia, annoyed, scolds him for the delay in fixing the fuse. Kishore then reveals the fuse was in the pump room, not where Rahul and Tia were looking, fixing it and adding to the awkwardness. Rahul decides to leave, checking his phone to avoid eye contact, while Tia acknowledges his departure. Rahul mentions starting a conversation with his partner. After Rahul leaves, Tia answers a call from "Bunkooo," expressing her drunken state and self-reproach. Later, Arjun and Tia are in a car with Boobly, who is lifting weights in the front seat while listening to an old Hindi song. Tia comments on the song, Boobly shares a fitness mantra, and Arjun jokes about his gym music. Tia then mentions her birthday and playfully requests a large cut-out of Boobly as a gift, expressing her attraction to him. Arjun, Wasim, and Tia then attend a bodybuilding competition, cheering loudly for Boobly. After the competition, Arjun and Tia walk back to Tia's house, discussing the event and their families, with Tia revealing her parents passed away when she was fourteen. Arjun apologizes and jokingly offers to trade his family for her bungalow. Later, at Tia's bungalow, Tia makes tea for Arjun. In Tia's bedroom, Arjun makes an inappropriate joke about a large bra he finds, which Tia clarifies belongs to "Bunkoo." Arjun asks Tia to contact him if "Bunkoo" ever doubts Sahil, then expresses frustration about his brother Rahul, wishing someone would give him a sedative. Tia questions Arjun about his arguments with Rahul, and Arjun reveals their "fucked up relationship" stems from Rahul publishing a novel that was almost exactly Arjun's story idea, which then became a bestseller. Arjun further explains that while the writing style and ending were different, the characters and storyline of Rahul's novel were very similar to his idea, making it too much of a coincidence for two brothers to have the same idea at the same time. He tells Tia he never confronted Rahul because he feared being accused of jealousy and his mother worried it would break the family. Arjun expresses his belief that if his name were on the novel's cover, publishers would be pursuing him, and his parents wouldn't see him as such a loser. Tia reassures him that he's not a loser and offers something to cheer him up. She hands him the bra he previously joked about, and Arjun, putting it on his heart, jokingly says he feels much better, then folds it and puts it in his pocket. Now, Arjun invites Tia to Grand Dad's surprise birthday party, which Tia playfully accepts, calling it a "geriatric ward reunion." Meanwhile, Rahul receives Arjun's luggage, discovering a broken lock and, more significantly, a draft of Arjun's unpublished novel, which he curiously examines. Grand Dad is discharged from the hospital and, on the way home with Harsh and Arjun, asks about Rahul and then playfully takes selfies on an iPad, much to Harsh's amusement. At the family house, which is decorated for Grand Dad's birthday, Rahul's mother tries to set him up with a girl named Geet. Rahul is visibly uncomfortable during their awkward conversation. In another part of the lawn, Tia arrives at the party and sees Arjun, who is trying to avoid Wasim taking his picture because he needs to use the bathroom. At the party, Tia greets Arjun and Wasim. Rahul is having an awkward conversation with Geet, who compliments his sweater. Tia comments on the party preparations, and Arjun jokes about becoming a professional balloon decorator. Rahul, trying to escape Geet, approaches Arjun and Tia, not noticing Tia at first. He complains about Geet trying to sell him an insurance policy. Tia then gets his attention, and Rahul is surprised to see her there. Arjun is also surprised to learn that Rahul and Tia already know each other. Rahul, conscious of the previous night's kiss with Tia, tries to explain his presence at Tia's bungalow by mentioning the retreat project. Tia, realizing Rahul and Arjun are brothers, expresses surprise at the "small world." Rahul offers Tia a drink. Wasim calls Arjun, who leaves to get Tia a drink. Tia then apologizes to Rahul for "last night," feeling weird, and hopes he isn't judging her. Rahul tries to respond, also feeling awkward.
data.scenedetails: The scene is at Grand Dad's decorated birthday party. Rahul, Arjun, and Tia are conversing. Rahul is trying to avoid Geet, who is attempting to sell him an insurance policy. Both Rahul and Tia are acutely aware of their unexpected kiss from the previous night, leading to an awkward tension between them. Arjun is currently unaware of their shared past. Wasim is also present, trying to take pictures of Arjun.
data.question: Does Rahul immediately and clearly explain to Arjun how he knows Tia, mentioning the retreat project, before Tia speaks?
